component.subject: Eucharist
component.title: The Cup
component.source: W. E. Orchard, The Order of Divine Service (1921), A Simple Observance of the Lord's Supper, p. 117 (Matthew 26:27-28). Lightly modernised; "for all people" per 1 Timothy 2:6 where Orchard has "for many".

original.p: After the same manner also, he took a cup, (Here the President may take the cup into his hands.) and gave thanks, Thanksgiving. and gave to them saying, Drink ye all of it; for this is my blood of the covenant, which is shed for many unto remission of sins.
This do as oft as ye drink it, in remembrance of me. (Here all partake of the cup.)

block.p: After the same manner he also took a cup,
block.rubric: Here the cup is taken up
block.p: and gave it to them, saying, Drink of it, all of you; for this is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for all people for the remission of sins.
This do, as often as you drink it, in remembrance of me.
block.rubric: Here all partake of the cup
